`openapi.json` in this directory is a copy of the OpenAPI document of the Askpilot
public API. `test_contract_openapi.py` reads the copy, and it pins the SDK to the
contract.

- Source: the Askpilot public API, https://public-api.askpilot.com
- Version of the service: `826c94ed961bf1cf7e5e8aa5228a0f9a233aa1ed`
- Date: 2026-09-11

The maintainer makes the document from the service, and saves it with an indent of
2. Then the maintainer writes the version and the date above.
